name: io.github.nhatvu148/video-transcriber-mcp
title: Video Transcriber
description: Transcribe videos from 1000+ platforms or local files offline, and search across every transcript

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Enables the semantic `search_transcripts` tool by embedding each transcript as it is saved. Transcription itself stays 100% offline and works without this.

environmentVariables.name: YT_DLP_COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Browser to pull cookies from for age-restricted or login-gated videos (e.g. 'firefox', 'chrome', 'brave').

environmentVariables.name: YT_DLP_COOKIES
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Netscape-format cookies.txt file, as an alternative to YT_DLP_COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER.
